  Terse gloss: "purple (Aramaic: purple dye or fabric, royal color)"

Daniel uses this word when describing the honors promised to whoever could interpret the writing on the wall: clothed in purple along with gold and a chain. Purple dye, extracted from Mediterranean mollusks, was extraordinarily expensive and therefore restricted to royalty and the wealthy elite. The color signified power, prestige, and privilege across ancient Near Eastern cultures."
